bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to local government; prohibiting municipalities from enforcing or enacting an ordinance prohibiting emergency housing facilities; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 462.352, subdivision 2; 462.357, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.352, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Municipality.
"Municipality" means any city, including a city operating under a home rule charter, and any town or township.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 1j.

Emergency housing facilities.

(a) For purposes of this subdivision, the term "emergency housing facility" means a facility that provides sleeping accommodations and restroom facilities on a day-to-day basis to persons without permanent housing for fewer than six months.

(b) A municipality shall not enact, amend, or enforce a zoning ordinance that prohibits emergency housing facilities, except in areas zoned as residential or agricultural.
